verdict.rationale: The SDK documents automatic schema generation and Pydantic-powered validation for function tools, and lists structured outputs as an agent feature. That is genuine first-party schema validation, but it runs when tools are called, not at build time. Missing for 10: evidence of strict static typing (type hints, TypeScript types, or type-checker support) that catches mistakes at build time; detail on how strict the schemas are; hands-on corroboration that a coding agent benefits from this.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on strict typing and schema validation so a coding agent catches its own mistakes at build time

citations.quote: Turn any Python function into a tool with automatic schema generation and Pydantic-powered validation.
optional runtime behavior such as handoffs, guardrails, and structured outputs
